On November 13, Baidu World 2025 was held in Beijing. At the event, Baidu Wenku and Baidu Wangpan officially launched GenFlow 3.0, which has over 20 million active users and has become the "world's largest general-purpose intelligent agent." Based on GenFlow 3.0, Baidu Wenku and Wangpan announced comprehensive upgrades and revealed their overseas progress for the first time. Baidu Wenku introduced a one-stop AI learning and office platform called "Oreate" overseas, while Baidu Wangpan was globally launched in September this year. After two years of restructuring, Baidu Wenku and Wangpan have become "super apps" with global influence, helping every user become a "super individual." 

GenFlow 3.0 was newly released, featuring two leading intelligent agents: Office Agent and GenX Agent. Following the launch of GenFlow 2.0 in August, Wenku and Wangpan completed the rapid iteration to GenFlow 3.0 in just over two months. As the world's first full-stack general-purpose intelligent agent, it boasts more powerful universal multimodal capabilities, breaking through limitations in content modalities, creative approaches, and expression interactions, fully enabling the input, processing, and output of all modal content. Currently, GenFlow 3.0 is officially available across all platforms of Wenku and Wangpan. 

Reportedly, GenFlow 3.0 adopts a centralized native Multi-Agent architecture, builds contextual engineering based on industry knowledge graphs, and has developed a self-researched "multimodal fusion editor," creating industry-leading specialized technical capabilities.
